# Goody — account brief

## Who
Goody is a gifting platform for sending personal and business gifts without needing an address ([source](https://ongoody.com/)). Its GitHub org is ongoody, linked to ongoody.com ([source](https://github.com/ongoody)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json is present in ongoody/goody-app ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/eas.json))
- react-native ~0.73.6 in the app's package.json ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json))
- CI workflows in ongoody/goody-app ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- 11 public repos and 64 followers on the org ([source](https://github.com/ongoody))
- 5,400 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157))

## Why now
The repo was last pushed on 2026-07-29 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app)). The app shipped 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)).

## Suggested opener
I saw goody-app has eas.json checked in, so you are already building with EAS ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/eas.json)). You shipped 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days on react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)) ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json)). At that release cadence, are store builds the bottleneck, or is it getting fixes out between submissions with updates?
